        self.concat = nn.Sequential(

            nn.Dropout(p=0.3)
        )

        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()
        self.fc = nn.Linear(16 * 32 * 32, 10)  # Assuming CIFAR-10

        branch_output = self.branch_path(x)
        merged = torch.add(main_output, branch_output)

        block2_1 = self.block2_1(merged)
